_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail: PocketMine-MP, Bedrock server software in PHP. The install takes PocketMine-MP.phar from pmmp's GitHub releases and pmmp's own PHP binary for Linux x86_64 (pmmp/PHP-Binaries, the PHP version the release's build_info.json names), each checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub lists; the binary runs on Octail's Debian 12 image (it needs glibc 2.35+ and libstdc++, its own libraries come with it). Tagged minecraft, bedrock and pocketmine with the minecraft_bedrock flag: the node pings it like a Bedrock server, and it gets none of Bedrock Dedicated Server's tools (its server.properties has on/off switches and its lists are white-list.txt and ops.txt) but the Players tab: names from the GameSpy4 query on the game port, kick, ban, pardon and messages as console commands (players preset pocketmine). No EULA: --no-wizard skips PocketMine's setup wizard, and the install writes server.properties so the first start already uses the server's port.
name: PocketMine-MP
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: PocketMine-MP is a server for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition (phones, tablets, consoles and Windows) written in PHP, with a large library of plugins. It is not made by Mojang: it has no vanilla world generation or mob AI, so it suits minigames, lobbies and plugin-driven servers best.

startup_commands.Default: if [ ! -x bin/php7/bin/php ] || [ ! -f PocketMine-MP.phar ]; then echo 'PocketMine-MP or its PHP binary is missing: reinstall the server (Settings, Reinstall).'; exit 1; fi; exec ./bin/php7/bin/php ./PocketMine-MP.phar --no-wizard --enable-ansi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# PocketMine-MP installation (Octail): PocketMine-MP.phar from pmmp's GitHub releases (latest or a version) and
# pmmp's own PHP binary for Linux x86_64 (github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries), both checked against the SHA-256 digests
# GitHub lists for the release assets. The PHP version is the one the release's build_info.json names, or the one
# staff pin. Plugins, worlds, players, server.properties and pocketmine.yml stay on reinstall.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
	echo "Installation failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 60 --retry 3 "$1"; }
download() { curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 --retry 3 -o "$2" "$1"; }
# The asset named $2 of the release JSON $1, as {name, url, sha256}; empty when it has none.
asset() {
	echo "$1" | jq -c --arg n "$2" '[.assets[] | select(.name == $n)][0] // empty
		| {name, url: .browser_download_url, sha256: ((.digest // "") | ltrimstr("sha256:") | ascii_downcase)}'
}
# Downloads asset JSON $1 to $2 and checks its SHA-256.
fetch_checked() {
	local name url sum
	name=$(echo "$1" | jq -r '.name')
	url=$(echo "$1" | jq -r '.url')
	sum=$(echo "$1" | jq -r '.sha256')
	echo "${sum}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "GitHub lists no SHA-256 for ${name}"
	download "${url}" "$2" || fail "the download of ${name} failed"
	if ! echo "${sum}  $2" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
		rm -f "$2"
		fail "${name} doesn't match its SHA-256 (${sum})"
	fi
}

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH}" in
x86_64 | amd64) ;;
*) fail "pmmp publishes PHP binaries for Linux x86_64 only, and this node is ${ARCH}" ;;
esac

VERSION="${PMMP_VERSION:-latest}"
PHP="${PHP_VERSION:-auto}"
echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^(latest|[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$' ||
	fail "the PocketMine-MP version (${VERSION}) must be a version such as 5.44.3 or latest"
echo "${PHP}" | grep -Eq '^(auto|[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$' || fail "the PHP version (${PHP}) must be auto or a version such as 8.2"

RELEASES=https://api.github.com/repos/pmmp/PocketMine-MP/releases
if [ "${VERSION}" = latest ]; then
	RELEASE=$(get "${RELEASES}/latest") || fail "GitHub didn't list the latest PocketMine-MP release"
else
	RELEASE=$(get "${RELEASES}/tags/${VERSION}") || fail "PocketMine-MP ${VERSION} isn't a release on GitHub"
fi
TAG=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '.tag_name // empty')
[ -n "${TAG}" ] || fail "GitHub's answer names no release"
PHAR=$(asset "${RELEASE}" PocketMine-MP.phar)
INFO=$(asset "${RELEASE}" build_info.json)
if [ -z "${PHAR}" ] || [ -z "${INFO}" ]; then
	fail "release ${TAG} has no PocketMine-MP.phar or build_info.json"
fi

WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${WORK}"' EXIT
fetch_checked "${INFO}" "${WORK}/build_info.json"
MAJOR="${TAG%%.*}"
if [ "${PHP}" = auto ]; then
	PHP=$(jq -r '.php_version // empty' "${WORK}/build_info.json")
	echo "${PHP}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' || fail "build_info.json of ${TAG} names no PHP version"
fi

PHP_TAG="pm${MAJOR}-php-${PHP}-latest"
PHP_RELEASE=$(get "https://api.github.com/repos/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/tags/${PHP_TAG}") ||
	fail "pmmp publishes no PHP ${PHP} binary for PocketMine-MP ${MAJOR} (release ${PHP_TAG})"
PHP_ASSET=$(asset "${PHP_RELEASE}" "PHP-${PHP}-Linux-x86_64-PM${MAJOR}.tar.gz")
[ -n "${PHP_ASSET}" ] || fail "release ${PHP_TAG} has no Linux x86_64 PHP binary"

echo "Installing PocketMine-MP ${TAG} with PHP ${PHP} (${PHP_TAG})"
fetch_checked "${PHAR}" "${WORK}/PocketMine-MP.phar"
fetch_checked "${PHP_ASSET}" "${WORK}/php.tar.gz"
mkdir -p "${WORK}/php"
tar -xzf "${WORK}/php.tar.gz" -C "${WORK}/php"
[ -f "${WORK}/php/bin/php7/bin/php" ] || fail "the PHP archive has no bin/php7/bin/php"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
rm -rf bin/php7
mkdir -p bin
mv "${WORK}/php/bin/php7" bin/php7
chmod +x bin/php7/bin/php
mv -f "${WORK}/PocketMine-MP.phar" PocketMine-MP.phar

# The binary was built in /home/runner: point its php.ini at the extensions (OPcache) where the server sees them.
EXT=$(find bin/php7/lib/php/extensions -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '*debug-zts*' | head -n 1)
[ -n "${EXT}" ] || fail "the PHP archive has no extension folder"
INI=bin/php7/bin/php.ini
sed -i '/^extension_dir=/d' "${INI}"
sed -i "1i extension_dir=\"/home/container/${EXT}\"" "${INI}"

mkdir -p plugins plugin_data worlds players
# The panel rewrites the port, IPv6 (off: containers publish IPv4 ports) and the query (the Players tab reads it)
# at every start. Writing them now means the first start already uses the server's port; the rest stays PocketMine's.
if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
	printf '%s\n' '#Properties Config file' 'server-port=19132' 'enable-ipv6=off' 'enable-query=on' >server.properties
fi

if [ ! -x bin/php7/bin/php ] || [ ! -f PocketMine-MP.phar ]; then
	fail "PocketMine-MP or its PHP binary is missing"
fi
echo "PocketMine-MP ${TAG} and PHP ${PHP} installed (SHA-256 checked). Put plugins (.phar) into plugins/."

variables.name: PocketMine-MP Version
variables.description: The PocketMine-MP release to install, such as 5.44.3, or latest for the newest stable release. Applied on the next reinstall.

variables.name: PHP Version
variables.description: The PHP binary to install from pmmp's PHP-Binaries: auto takes the version the PocketMine-MP release names, or pin one such as 8.2.
